prompts.material: Original GAME TERRAIN MATERIAL ATLAS for a crisp detailed 2D chibi wuxia RPG. FOUR seamless repeatable top-down pavement/material patches in a strict 2x2 grid, NO gutters, NO labels, NO borders, NO scenery, NO characters, NO lighting gradients or shadows. Each cell is entirely filled edge to edge with its own repeatable material. Top left: warm pale rose-beige rectangular courtyard paving blocks, clean dark fine grout, small crisp stone bevels, matching DH-B peach island. Top right: cold charcoal blue-grey small irregular fortress cobblestones, narrow dark grout, crisp chipped facets and sparse moss, matching TD-B wartime night. Bottom left: cool moonlit blue-grey rectangular refined stone paving blocks with clean sharp bevels, matching TH-B lotus manor. Bottom right: rich dark redwood planks, narrow dark joints and small clear grain, warm highlights. Each material cell should wrap seamlessly at its own left/right and top/bottom edges. Dense authored material detail and intentional clean one-pixel-like contour groups, NOT soft watercolor, NOT photographic textures, NOT 3D render, NO blur/no glow/no grain/no vignette. Keep a consistent small stone/plank scale within each cell, about 8 stones or boards across its width. Target high-resolution atlas with sharp natural game-sprite quality; neutral flat overhead lighting. The provided map references supply color and material identity only; do NOT reproduce their map layout.
